name: Biofeedback
body:
Discipline psychometabolism; Level dread 1, gifted blade 1, psion/wilder 2, psychic warrior 1, vitalist 1

MANIFESTING

Display Material and visual
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Power Points dread 1, gifted blade 1, psion/wilder 3, psychic warrior 1, vitalist 1

DESCRIPTION

You can toughen your body against wounds, lessening their impact. For the duration of this power, you gain damage reduction 2/–.

Augment For every 3 additional power points you spend, your damage reduction increases by 1.
